title: Analista de Planejamento e Dados em RH
description:
Join to apply for the Analista de Planejamento e Dados em RH role at AdviceHealth

Somos a AdviceHealth! Somos uma healthtech especializada em tecnologia e serviços para o setor da saúde suplementar, atendendo +100 clientes em todo o Brasil.

Entregamos em nossas soluções conhecimento técnico científico com tecnologia integrada contribuindo para a sustentabilidade das operadoras de saúde e do setor da saúde suplementar como um todo.

Nossos valores são a determinação, integridade, iniciativa, foco no cliente, aprendizado contínuo e superação. Se você se identificou com a gente e também acredita que é sempre possível fazer melhor, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a Vaga

Como Analista de Planejamento de RH , você será imprescindível em processos que envolvem ações como:

  1. Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento da área de Recursos Humanos, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros.
  2. Analyzar e monitorar os custos relacionados à folha de pagamento, identificando oportunidades de otimização e redução de despesas.
  3. Colaborar com a equipe financeira na elaboração de projeções orçamentárias e análises de viabilidade econômico-financeira.
  4. Realizar análises de rentabilidade de programas e iniciativas de RH, fornecendo insights para a tomada de decisão.
  5. Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento estratégico da empresa, contribuindo com informações e análises relacionadas a RH e custos.
  6. Desenvolver e manter controles internos relacionados ao orçamento de RH, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da empresa.
  7. Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos de planejamento financeiro e orçamentário da área de RH.
  8. Criar e manter indicadores de desempenho da área de RH, gerando relatórios e análises para a tomada de decisão estratégica.
  9. Preparar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações para a alta administração, comunicando de forma clara e objetiva os resultados e análises realizados.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Econômicas, Estatística, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, com habilidade para criar fórmulas complexas, gráficos dinâmicos e macros.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de RH (ERP) e ferramentas de Business Intelligence será considerado um diferencial.
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade para interpretar dados complexos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Foco em resultados e orientação para a resolução de problemas.

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Transporte com desconto reduzido para 3% sobre o salário, um apoio para o deslocamento até a empresa.
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição, supermercado ou restaurante? Escolha ou ainda faça um mix de sua preferência, são mais de R$1 mil de benefício sem desconto em folha.
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed após o período de experiência, mensalidade sem custo para o colaborador, sendo pago apenas a coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico Uniodonto após o período de experiência, 100% gratuito para manter o sorriso sempre em dia.
  • Auxílio Creche para ter um local seguro para seus pequenos dependentes.
  • Day Off de Aniversário para você aproveitar o seu dia do jeito que preferir.
  • Programa AdviceMoment, benefício focado em saúde e bem-estar, tendo WellHub (antigo Gympass) e apoio com a nossa educadora física.
  • Plataformas Educacionais, Alura, Next e Hacker Rangers - Mais de 1.550 cursos de capacitação em saúde, tecnologia e inovação.

Aviso de Privacidade: Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo, tratados de acordo com os níveis de segurança adotados pela AdviceHealth. Em caso de dúvidas sobre a privacidade dos dados ou qualquer aspecto relacionado ao tratamento realizado, entre em contato pelo canal: Acesse nosso Aviso de Privacidade em para saber mais sobre como tratamos dados pessoais na AdviceHealth.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
At Nexla, we’re a pioneer in automating data engineering with the mission to make ready-to-use data available to anyone, anywhere. Recognized as a Gartner Cool Vendor, Nexla is built on logical Data Products (Nexsets) at its core, resulting in a data platform that seamlessly offers multi-speed data integration, preparation, monitoring, and governance in a no-code/low-code interface Doordash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, and LiveRamp are among the many data-driven enterprises that trust Nexla for their mission-critical data.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Senior level Software engineer on the backend software team to architect, develop and deliver backend solutions for our customers. A successful candidate will be well versed in the core principles and practices of system architecture for cloud services and have hands-on experience in building high throughput and large volume handling software systems. This role will be focused on working on the core part of Nexla’s backend software which enables and runs the flows. This is part of a very small team and you’ll be expected to be resourceful, a selfless team player, and regularly go above and beyond your “day job”. The upside is unbound growth opportunities and a chance to design greenfield software that handles huge amounts of data.

This position is Remote but candidates are to be located in South America

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop solutions for backend software using Java
  • Work on large scale problems of Data Engineering and design software to handle huge amounts of data (both transient and persistent)
  • Be part of the on-call rotation for your team to provide support on software
  • Bring knowledge of new technologies into the team, that will make Nexla’s platform more efficient and robust for the product
  • Collaborate with additional Nexla technical resources in Product, engineering, CSM, support etc. to solve customer issues
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams (Backend, API, UI etc.) to work on projects together
  • Build and design tools to monitor our systems better

What You Bring to Nexla

  • Enthusiasm and curiosity to learn new technologies and software architectures
  • Min. 7+ years of platform and backend software development in mid size or large scale engineering organizations
  • Excellent communication skills - being able to connect the dots in the feature requirements to enable software development of those features
  • Deep understanding and recent hands on experience of high throughput and low latency systems written in JVM based languages (Java or similar backend languages)
  • Experience and understanding of working on backend infrastructure: Kubernetes, Kafka, Caches (Redis, Memcache), Databases and communication protocols (gRPC, REST)
  • Experience in working with various data formats (JSON, Parquet, Avro etc.)
  • Ability to write code in the programming languages (like Java, Python etc.), deep understanding on how APIs work, ability to write and optimize SQL
  • Ability to connect a customer’s specific business problems and Nexla’s solutions
  • Ability to work in a team environment with other engineers in the platform team and mentor other engineers on backend infrastructure and system architecture design patterns

Plurality is what makes our Big Dream possible.

We are called ebankers and we are changing the way people buy, connect, and live globally. Let's make history together?

About the Position: We are looking for a Mid-Level Data Reliability Engineer to join our Data Platform Engineering team responsible for our platform that facilitates the visualization and communication between ebankers. You will work in conjunction with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analysts Engineers, and Software Engineering teams to ensure the reliable delivery of data that supports business decisions. And will mainly participate in the development of data governance solutions and DBRE initiatives.

As a DRE inside this team, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring the quality, reliability, and availability of data in large-scale systems.
  • Developing and maintaining robust, fault-tolerant data pipelines.
  • Implementing and improving monitoring and alerting systems to detect issues in real time.
  • Building and maintaining backup, recovery, and automation solutions to enhance data reliability.
  • Investigating and resolving data quality issues, such as inconsistencies and duplicates.
  • Collaborating with teams from different departments, including Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, to ensure efficient use of data.
  • Defining and monitoring data reliability metrics, like SLAs and SLOs, to maintain high standards.

What is indispensable for the job?

  • Experience with developing data pipelines or automating data-related tasks.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch).
  • Practical experience with data services in at least one Cloud platform: AWS or GCP.
  • Familiarity with data quality concepts.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work in a team.

What else we would love to see?

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform).
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Understanding of basic SRE principles applied to data.
  • Experience with deploying and monitoring cloud infrastructure.

  • EBANX Flexible: monthly Day Off from February to November, birthday Day Off and Rest up Month - one month of paid leave every three years of work anniversary.
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

The Finance team at TRACTIAN is responsible for managing the company’s financial health and ensuring sustainable growth. This team oversees financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis, ensuring that all departments have the resources they need to operate efficiently. As a Fiscal Analyst, you will be responsible for managing the operational processes related to auxiliary tax obligations and addressing day-to-day fiscal challenges.   • Oversee and ensure the accurate preparation and submission of auxiliary tax obligations (e.g., SPED, EFD-Contribuições, ECF).

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to maintain up-to-date knowledge of fiscal policies and requirements.

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 31 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.
Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you

Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.
Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. A Snapshot of Your Day

The role of a Product Detail Design Checker involves checking and verifying all drawings, models, assemblies, and bills of material to project requirements and standards. The models and drawings include 3D NX models, 2D line work, and reference information to ensure downstream understanding. Daily activities may include attending scope kickoff meetings, addressing queries from manufacturing facilities and vendors, and mentoring team members. Excellent collaboration and communication are essential, and this position offers growth opportunities beyond the core checker role, including interaction with the global Siemens-Energy Turbo Compression Products Organization.

  • Adhere to safety protocols and ensure engineering and design processes are followed with necessary approvals.

  • Apply drafting and engineering standards, focusing on economical manufacturing, and perform self-reviews for accuracy.
  • Provide training to less experienced team members and support manufacturing, purchasing, and quality teams.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design tools, standards, and product offerings.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering, or related experience in drafting and rotating machinery such as turbo-compressors or centrifugal pumps. More experienced candidates may be considered for senior roles.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Ability to work independently and in teams on complex projects, demonstrating adaptability and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, advanced CAD tools, ERP systems (SAP or Oracle), and PLM systems (Team Center/Globus).
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (~5-15%).

Our Transformation of Industry division focuses on decarbonizing the industrial sector through electrification and efficiency, supporting the transition to sustainable processes with a global industrial customer base and diverse technologies.

Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.

Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Especialista Técnico em Equipamentos de Diagnóstico por Imagem , você será responsável por garantir a instalação, manutenção e suporte técnico dos nossos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem, garantindo a qualidade e a confiabilidade de nossos produtos no campo. Seu trabalho será essencial para o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos nos hospitais e clínicas, sempre buscando a excelência no atendimento aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Treinar usuários sobre a operação e manutenção dos equipamentos;
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar reparos de acordo com os procedimentos da empresa;
  • Acompanhar e controlar os indicadores de performance dos equipamentos, gerando relatórios técnicos para os gestores;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.);

Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de equipamentos médicos ou saúde.

title: Commercial Manager - Betfair Brazil
description:
Job title: Commercial Manager

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Overview of the role:

Betfair is looking for a Commercial Manager to play a critical role in designing, implementing and monitoring the regionalised sports & gaming strategy for Brazil, one of Betfair International’s key markets.

Our new Sao Paulo workspace is the perfect place for team collaboration and individual growth. It is located in the Paulista neighbourhood with great transport links across the city and exciting working environment.

What you’ll do:

  1. Commercial Touchpoint – support senior commercial stakeholders as the key touchpoint within the Commercial team for inputting priorities across key relevant business functions: e.g. Marketing, Product, Customer operations, Risk and Trading, etc.

  2. Pricing & Risk Strategies – be the Brazilian customer’s commercial voice, inputting into defining our Pricing strategy and working closely with the trading team ensure its delivery.

  3. Commercial Understanding – supporting the analysis and interpretation of performance, growth indicators, and competitor drivers. Working with key commercial leaders to continually identify areas for strategic and operational improvements that support our Brazilian business.

  4. License and Regulations – support senior commercial and Brazilian steerco stakeholders with the defining, scoping, prioritisation and delivery of relevant regulatory requirements necessary for Betfair International’s Brazilian license. On an ongoing basis, support any regulatory changes in markets as required.

  5. Betfair International Team – lead a small team responsible for on-site quality assurance, testing new products and journeys to ensure our customers receive the best possible experience across our website.

  6. Presentations – play a key role in creating insight from data, making strategic recommendations, and preparation of materials that will be shared with senior management: e.g. the Betfair International Monthly Business Review (MBR) pack.

  7. Brazilian Tribe – contribute to the Brazilian tribe, sharing key insights and localised knowledge with other members, both internal and external to the Tribe, and through completion of weekly wrap up.

  8. Brand localisation – Act as point of contact for Marketing and CRM teams, helping shape locally relevant customer communications, ensuring content plans are in-line with principles established from commercial senior management.

What you’ll bring:

  1. Results orientated – You are a proactive self-starter who can seek out opportunities and work independently to deliver against them.

  2. Cross functional player – can build positive relationships across a sophisticated organisation to give clarity of objectives and support effective delivery of strategic objectives.

  3. Data driven – you are comfortable unpicking data to identify key insights and building a clear, concise and accurate narrative to express what we are and are not doing effectively.

  4. Stakeholder management – strong interpersonal and communication skills, to form strong working relationships across a matrixed organisation.

  5. Courage – you work through difficult problems with partners in an honest and reasoned way, to support the best delivery of solutions for Betfair International.

  6. Customer Obsessed – builds and delivers solutions that exceed customer expectations; prioritises customer satisfaction and builds commitment in others to provide outstanding service.

Your experience:

  1. Excellent verbal and written English communication is crucial.

  2. A good understanding of the global Gambling market.

  3. High emotional IQ, with an ability and passion to handle transitional phases effectively.

  4. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to collaborate optimally.

  5. Great teammate with personal characteristics that engender trust and confidence.

  6. Inquisitive, always asking why & not stopping until the problem has been solved.

  7. The ability to learn and share the assimilated knowledge to stakeholders of different seniority.

It’s ok if you don’t think you tick every box on this list. We love people who want to challenge themselves and are passionate about what they do. If you believe you can contribute in some areas and are eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Why choose us:

Aside from a generous base salary, we have a fantastic benefits & rewards program that is designed to encourage personal and career development.

  1. Discretionary annual performance bonus.

  2. 13th Month Payment.

  3. Annual Salary Increase.

  4. Long Term Disability (LTD).

  5. Health and dental insurance for you, your partner and your children (if you all live at the same address).

  6. Personal life insurance and income protection.

  7. A personal interest allowance to let you learn something new or pursue a hobby.

  8. Employee Assistance Programme.

  9. Transportation and Childcare Allowance.

  10. R$ 1000 per month in Meal Vouchers.

  11. Maternity Leave - 26 weeks paid, Paternity Leave 4 weeks paid.

  12. External learning support of up to £2,000 or equivalent in local currency, dedicated 4 learning “Power Hours” every month during office time, full access to the Udemy and Mindtools platforms, in-house leadership program and many other training opportunities for developing your skills and progressing your career.

  13. Family Reward.

Equal opportunities:

At Flutter International we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where our people can be their authentic selves and thrive. We embrace and celebrate diversity, respecting all our uniqueness and differences.

We welcome you to let us know whether you have any accessibility needs. All you need to do is email us at . Your journey with us is focused on ensuring you have what you need to be your best self.

Learn more about the works we are doing on Inclusion and Belonging here:

The group:

Betfair International is a proud member of the Flutter Entertainment family, a global leader in sports betting, iGaming, and entertainment. We're not just another company; we're listed on both the prestigious FTSE 100 index on the London Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). What sets us apart is our world class brands, cutting-edge products, and our International division includes our operations in over 100 global markets and offers sports betting, casino, poker, rummy and lottery, mainly online. What truly defines us is our commitment to ensuring that the excitement of gaming and entertainment is experienced in a responsible and sustainable way. Our remarkable team of over 8,000 colleagues drives this vision, spread across 28 offices worldwide.

Our Local Programs and Regulatory Compliance team is responsible for ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations in the countries where we operate.

About the role:

The Compliance Analyst II shall be responsible for supporting Crypto.com in ensuring the Company’s activities are in line with the Brazilian regulatory framework as well as supporting on dealing with AML investigative cases. Additionally, the person responsible for the role shall ensure that the SISBAJUD/CCS protocols are followed and support the law enforcement responses.


Responsibilities
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Identify areas of non-compliance or partial compliance of the business through a GAP analysis of applicable laws and regulations and prepare and implement an action plan to remedy any shortfalls;
  • Monitor and review all developments within the regulatory environment of the business; enforce adherence to requirements; advise management on needed actions;
  • Ensure that any updates to the legislative and regulatory framework are communicated to all stakeholders and training provided if required;
  • Assist with the periodic review of policies and training ensuring they are compliant with the applicable regulatory regime in Brazil;
  • Continually and actively develop technical knowledge concerning the regulatory framework governing the company and its activities;

  • Internal Controls
  • Manage internal compliance operational controls, and carry out independent reviews and examinations as required;
  • Identify, highlight and manage regulatory risks, findings and recommendations identified internally, by independent reviews or examinations;
  • Work with management and staff to ensure that the business implements and maintains suitable systems and controls to meet the regulatory requirements;

  • Reporting
  • Assist in responding to law enforcement requests and inquiries;
  • Prepare compliance audit data by compiling and analyzing internal information;
  • Liaise with other departments to prepare data required for the submission of reports requested by the regulating authorities.

  • AML/CFT Compliance
  • Liaise with the Compliance Team to ensure that sufficient EDD has been requested and obtained on customers in accordance to their risk rating, as well as to properly assess whether the customer is involved in ML/FT;
  • Carry out customer account reviews to determine whether a reasonable suspicion of ML/FT exists;
  • Review and further investigate adverse media, PEP and sanction-related escalations;
  • Extract and compile customer data required for the submission of external reports with the regulatory authority and responding to Law Enforcement Requests;
  • Ensure proper and timely handling of internal unusual activity reports;
  • Prepare and file STR’s to COAF;
  • Assist in the drafting and implementation of internal procedures to facilitate the escalation process;
  • Implement the Company’s AML/CFT policies and procedures;
  • Maintain a working knowledge of local AML/CFT regulations, best practices, internal controls, and AML/CFT risk management practices.

Requirements
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience working with (i) a financial institution (payment service provider/e-money) and preferably experience also within the virtual financial assets market; or (ii) a law firm handling compliance matters relating to AML, licensing and applicable payments services laws and regulations;
  • Understanding of AML regulations and payments services legislation within the banking/financial services industry;
  • Ability to distill and discern important information from regulatory guidance, statutes and regulations, audit findings, and other documents and determine how it impacts the business. The understanding of regulatory requirements vs. “best practices” in compliance is critical;
  • Must be able to perform independently and with minimal supervision;
  • Strong organizational skills – must be multi-tasked oriented and able to balance pressure and deadlines with constantly changing priorities;
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize workload in line with tight deadlines and work effectively under pressure;
  • Experience interacting with local regulators a plus;

description:
Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas Negras - Estágio e Efetivo - Associado de Consultoria

ASAP está comprometida com a inclusão, diversidade e equidade, utilizando a tecnologia para impulsionar a inovação e a competitividade em toda a sociedade. Como líder global em software empresarial, a SAP ajuda organizações a enfrentar desafios com eficiência e produtividade. A empresa valoriza habilidades diversas e busca criar um ambiente de trabalho equitativo e inclusivo, onde os colaboradores possam crescer e alcançar o sucesso.

Este programa convida pessoas que se identificam como pessoas negras a se juntarem à SAP, candidatando-se a esta oportunidade. A inscrição não impede os candidatos de explorarem outras oportunidades dentro da SAP.

Se precisar de alguma adaptação específica ou assistência especial para o seu sucesso durante o processo de entrevista, informe-nos com antecedência. Envie um e-mail com sua solicitação para a equipe de Operações de Recrutamento:

Visão Geral

Associado de Consultoria em Processos de Negócios desempenha um papel fundamental na tradução da visão dos clientes em soluções inovadoras e práticas. Ele apoia o mapeamento de processos de negócios e requisitos de soluções, auxiliando na transformação para a Empresa Inteligente, aplicando melhores práticas, metodologias avançadas e padrões SAP.

Essa função envolve o design e a configuração de soluções SAP, tanto on-premise, em nuvem ou híbridas, para diferentes setores e linhas de negócios.

Esse profissional apoia projetos de consultoria por meio de atividades como suporte, revisão de soluções, resolução de problemas e envolvimento em projetos conduzidos por parceiros. Além disso, apresenta as melhores práticas da SAP e do setor, conduz treinamentos para equipes de clientes e documenta os serviços prestados. Seu trabalho garante implementações bem-sucedidas do portfólio de serviços da SAP, apoiando testes de solução e resolução de problemas.

Principais Responsabilidades e Tarefas

Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Processos de Negócios:

  • Criar e implementar processos detalhados, incentivando a inovação e padronizando os serviços oferecidos.
  • Projetar processos específicos para diferentes setores ou empresas, garantindo alinhamento com as melhores práticas e a estratégia de Empresa Inteligente da SAP.
  • Identificar serviços empresariais essenciais e recomendar soluções SAP e de terceiros, garantindo sua integração com os processos, aplicações e o ambiente de TI do cliente.
  • Avaliar tendências de mercado e tecnologia, desenvolvendo mapas de processos e soluções por setor.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico do portfólio interno e fortalecer as ofertas de serviços específicas para cada setor.
  • Mapear processos de negócios para a arquitetura de TI da empresa, garantindo uma integração eficiente no ambiente tecnológico.
  • Definir requisitos para customizações e integrações, quando as soluções padrão não forem suficientes.
  • Realizar revisões de processos e sistemas, assegurando alinhamento e eficiência operacional.
  • Apoiar a definição de estruturas organizacionais, indicadores de desempenho e métricas-chave, junto ao Gerente de Transformação.
  • Implementar novos processos, otimizando as funções empresariais dos clientes.

Requisitos de Experiência e Educação

  • Experiência: Não é necessária experiência prévia, porém experiências anteriores em áreas relacionadas (experiência funcional com qualquer módulo ou solução SAP, com conhecimento da Intelligent Enterprise Suite e seus processos end-to-end) serão um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado e conhecimento de outros idiomas adicionais são um diferencial.
  • Formação: Curso técnico ou graduação (concluída ou em andamento) em Administração de Empresas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas afins. Certificações ou formação técnica em áreas especializadas também são valorizadas.

Competências Essenciais

  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de compreender processos de negócios complexos e transformá-los em soluções eficientes, utilizando as melhores práticas da SAP.
  • Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para trabalhar com diferentes módulos SAP e atender às diversas necessidades empresariais de cada setor.
  • Foco no Cliente: Forte orientação para entender e atender às necessidades do cliente, promovendo um relacionamento de confiança e sucesso.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar soluções de forma clara, conduzir treinamentos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Abordagem criativa para solucionar desafios específicos dos clientes, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções otimizadas.

Na SAP, estamos comprometidos com a inovação, diversidade e crescimento pessoal e profissional, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo em diferentes culturas e países. Como líder global em software empresarial, nossa missão é tornar o mundo melhor e melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Junte-se ao nosso time, onde você fará parte de um ambiente vibrante e colaborativo, ajudando os clientes a terem sucesso com as soluções SAP.

Animado para começar sua jornada na SAP? Candidate-se hoje com seu currículo em inglês e traga sua autenticidade para a nossa equipe!

AVIAREPS has more than 30 years’ experience providing professional passenger GSA services and tourism marketing to clients around the globe. As the world’s leading GSA and Tourism representation organization with 65 offices in 59 countries, AVIAREPS represents airlines as well as destinations, hotels, attractions, airports, cars, trains, cruise lines, retailers and import/export organizations, and offers a full suite of B2B and B2C services which includes sales & reservations, marketing, digital, and PR programs.   • Market Research and Analysis : Gather market intelligence, analyze data, and identify potential opportunities.

  • Client Communication : Maintain consistent reporting and communication with clients.
  • Event Participation : Represent the company at fairs, events, and workshops to enhance visibility and networking.

Key Skills

  • Educational Background : Degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Economics, Communication, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Professional Experience : Extensive experience in tourism sales, including at least one role within an airline.
  • Industry Knowledge : Strong understanding of Brazil’s tourism trade, leisure and corporate travel sectors, consumer behavior, and market trends.
  • Sales Expertise : Proven track record in sales within the airline and tourism industries.
  • Segment Knowledge : Deep familiarity with travel and tourism industry segments and distribution channels.
  • Technical Skills : Advanced proficiency in MS Office programs; familiarity with tourism distribution tools (e.g., GDS) and systems like e-Smash is a plus.

title: Data Protection Analyst (1785)
description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Hy Cite Embu das Artes, São Paulo, Brazil

Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC
At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.
Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.
We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil
What The Role Involves
The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.
Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.
What We’re Looking For
  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.
Ready to Apply?
If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.
Hy Cite is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, recognizing that it builds stronger teams. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take our responsibility seriously to consider qualified applicants on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by applicable law.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review

  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Lead Testing & Quality Senior Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Testing & Quality Senior Engineer to drive the validation, reliability, and compliance of our hardware and software solutions. This role is crucial in ensuring our mission-critical systems meet the highest performance, security, and regulatory standards.


Qualifications

  • Expertise in software testing methodologies, with special focus on embedded systems and AI/ML pipelines.
  • Proficiency in test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, PyTest, Robot Framework, or custom CI/CD pipelines).
  • Strong experience with cross-compilation toolchains for embedded systems (e.g., OpenWRT, Yocto, Buildroot).
  • Hands-on experience with IoT, networking, and industrial communication protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC-UA, LTE/5G, TSN).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and penetration testing methodologies.
  • Experience with cloud-based testing environments (AWS, Azure) and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001, Six Sigma, and other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Programming experience in Python, Java, or C++ for test scripting and automation.
  • Knowledge of automated test tools and AI-driven test optimization.
  • Experience with railway standards testing and safety validation for rail systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining technology, or automotive-grade hardware validation.
  • Knowledge of safety-critical systems and regulatory frameworks.
  • Familiarity with machine learning model validation in real-time operational environments.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.
  • Effective communication and ability to work with cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, product, and field teams).
  • Ability to lead a quality-driven culture within the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Define and implement comprehensive testing strategies for hardware, firmware, and software applications in industrial mining environments.
  • Lead test automation efforts for real-time AI, IoT, and edge computing solutions.
  • Develop and execute performance, security, and reliability testing for mission-critical systems.
  • Establish and enforce quality control (QC) and quality assurance (QA) processes across development teams.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software engineers to enhance testability and ensure compliance with industry standards.
  • Oversee field testing validation campaigns, including environmental stress testing (temperature, humidity, vibration) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) validation.
  • Define and monitor key quality metrics (MTBF, MTTR, defect rates, failure analysis) to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with safety and mission-critical standards, including ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), AEC-Q100 (Automotive Electronics), IEC 61508 (Safety of Electrical/Electronic/Programmable Systems), and IEC 62443 (Industrial Cybersecurity).
  • Ensure compliance with railway standards and testing procedures, including EN 50126 (RAMS for railway applications), EN 50128 (Software for railway control systems), and EN 50129 (Safety-related electronic systems in railway signaling).
  • Utilize AI-driven tools to optimize test coverage and automate defect detection.
  • Manage data collection and analytics to improve testing efficiency and predict system failures.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity best practices, especially in connected mining infrastructure.
  • Manage test labs, tools, and automation frameworks to optimize validation workflows.
  • Work with customers, regulators, and internal stakeholders to address quality-related inquiries and certifications.

Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

  • Organiza e operacionaliza as atividades de gestão dos estoques sob a sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para atingir e garantir que os controles e entradas e saídas de materiais sejam eficazes, além do cumprimento de todas as normas, procedimentos e políticas de controle de inventários estabelecidos pela companhia.

O seu impacto

  • Efetuar a entrada no Sistema SAP de todo material recebido de outras unidades e terceiros.
  • Recontagem dos materiais que apresentarem divergência no momento do seu recebimento.
  • Correção das divergências de quantidades existentes com as origens, mediante recebimento ou emissão de notas fiscais. Atendimento a 28 CDV's e 5 CD's.
  • Correções de lote e validade dos materiais que apresentarem divergência entre o apontamento físico e o teórico.
  • Solicitação de contagem cíclica diária para validação de erros de movimentação e identificação de possíveis divergências entre o estoque físico e teórico. Média de 20 contagens por dia.
  • Análise das divergências encontradas e ações de correção junto às áreas responsáveis (CD's, CDV's, Manufatura, Coopeckeres e prestador de serviço). Média de 20 por dia.
  • Acompanhamento das Zonas intermediárias de transição de materiais no sistema SAP, garantindo que não haja pendências por erros de movimentação dos usuários ou do sistema. Atendimento à norma de GCS SOX.
  • Preparação do estoque para contagem física do material alocado no armazém.
  • Acompanhamento, análise, apuração e finalização do inventário realizado.
  • Rastreabilidade e bloqueio no sistema SAP dos materiais retidos por motivo de qualidade.
  • Baixas por avaria operacional. Atendimento à norma de GCS SOX.
  • Separação e baixa de materiais solicitados por outros centros de custos. Atendimento à norma de GCS SOX.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Conhecimento em fluxo de gestão de estoque, inventário, sistema SAP, além de boas práticas de qualidade e segurança.
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou curso técnico completo (sem restrição de área).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no 2º turno: das 14h20 às 22h35, de segunda a sábado.

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem-estar, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbrio para a sua saúde física, mental e integral.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

Consultor Comercial Programa de Desenvolvimento

Nosso programa dura três meses, e você é remunerado para treinar - Grupo Vivart - Cuiabá MT

O Grupo Vivart, em Cuiabá, está lançando um programa Trainee Comercial inovador, desenvolvido sob medida para identificar e formar novos talentos na área comercial do mercado imobiliário .

Se você busca uma carreira dinâmica, com potencial de crescimento e a oportunidade de fazer parte de algo grandioso, esta é a sua chance!

Nosso programa intensivo de três meses oferece uma imersão completa no universo das vendas imobiliárias.

Você terá a oportunidade de adquirir conhecimentos e habilidades essenciais que o(a) capacitarão a atuar como um Consultor de Vendas de alta performance , pronto para contribuir ativamente para o sucesso da nossa equipe comercial.

Seja parte da revolução no MERCADO IMOBILIÁRIO.

Nossos Lançamentos estão chegando em 2025.

Por gentileza leia toda a descrição da vaga, antes de enviar o currículo.

Objetivos Gerais do Programa Trainee:

  1. Qualificar Leads: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de marketing para entender os leads gerados e qualificá-los com base em critérios específicos que indicam seu potencial de compra.
  2. Prospectar Potenciais Clientes: Usar técnicas de prospecção, como pesquisas de mercado e utilização de redes sociais, para identificar e abordar novos potenciais clientes.
  3. Agendar Visitas: Desenvolver habilidades de comunicação e persuasão para agendar visitas com os leads qualificados e potenciais clientes.
  4. Agendamentos: Cada trainee deve realizar, no mínimo, 3 agendamentos por dia.
  5. Visitas Efetivas: O objetivo é concretizar 1 visita efetivada por dia.
  6. Acompanhamento Regular: Realizar reuniões semanais com os trainees para discutir progresso, desafios enfrentados e estratégias para melhoria.
  7. Programa de Feedback: Oferecer feedback constante e construtivo aos trainees durante todo o processo.

Bolsa de três meses no valor de R$ 2.000,00 por mês (dois mil reais), e bonificação de R$50,00 (cinquenta reais) por visita realizada. Ao alcançar 20 visitas efetivadas no mês, o trainee recebe uma bonificação adicional de R$ 1.000,00 (mil reais).

Ao final do programa, os trainees estarão preparados para assumir a posição de consultor júnior, com conhecimentos e habilidades para o mercado imobiliário, recebendo comissão de 1,5% a 2% por venda efetivada.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comercial
  • Necessário estar cursando nível superior

title: Investment Operations Associate
description:
Description

Join Our Dynamic Team and Elevate Your Career!

Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Apply for our exciting role and enjoy a range of benefits that will help you grow both professionally and personally:

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with colleagues from all levels and different teams within the organization, fostering a collaborative environment and learning from diverse perspectives.
  • Global Exposure: Gain international experience by coordinating investment documentation for institutional pension client portfolios in the US and Canada, and understand different market dynamics.
  • Impactful Work: Take on significant responsibilities such as reviewing and executing formal agreements, directly impacting the investment activities of institutional pension clients.
  • Project Management: Utilize your strong project management skills to organize, plan, and execute projects efficiently.
  • Communication Skills: Effectively communicate with fund managers, custodians, and other external parties, as well as internal teams.
  • Legal and Financial Expertise: Dive into the financial contracts and legal terminology, perfect for those with a keen interest in the legal and financial aspects of investment operations.
  • Autonomy and Teamwork: Enjoy the balance of working independently as a self-starter while also being a team player who fits seamlessly into the wider practice.

This position will be responsible to perform legal reviews and manages the signatures (executions) of the necessary documentation for the implementation or on-boarding of Investment Managers (these are investment management companies (funds and other assets authorized to be used for pensions under ERISA)) that will be part of our investment portfolios in one way or another for our clients in the USA and CAN.

The Investment Operations Associate will coordinate legal and investment review activities to assist the Implementation Team with its portfolio activities.

As a member of the Management Onboarding Team (within the larger Operations Team), you will initiate efficient processes for reviewing and implementing agreements on behalf of our institutional pension clients. The role requires the ability to collaborate on cross-functional teams with colleagues from all levels, while effectively communicating opinions and ideas in a succinct and coherent manner.

The Role

  • Incorporate key details in the preparation of agreements, and related documentation pertaining to investing the assets of retirement plans with investment managers.
  • Review client documents (including plan documents, trust agreements, investment policies) as it relates to the AML (anti-money laundering)/KYC (know your customer) process.
  • Effectively communicate with fund managers, custodians, and other external parties involved to ensure all agree on a trade timeline.
  • Learn about the wider investment consulting business by gaining exposure to numerous facets of the industry and have opportunities to work with multiple different teams within the organization.
  • Develop collaborative relationships and openly communicate on work matters with internal teams.
  • Effectively interact with internal teams to keep them informed on progress and ensure they carry out any required actions.

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • At least five years in an investment operations environment
  • Undergraduate degree
  • Project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines are critical
  • Ability to be a self-starter and work independently, but also cooperatively in a team environment
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills in English is a must
  • Understanding of financial contracts and legal terminology
  • Understanding of investment fund structure
  • Team-player with the ability to fit seamlessly into the wider practice
  • Microsoft office advanced (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, mainly)
  • Ability to liaise with third-party organizations (Investment Managers and Custodians/Banks) and with all levels of staff within the practice
  • Experience in making agreements, reviewing and/or legal documentary in Fiduciary or Trust Fund environment with Pension Fund.

Equal Opportunity Employer

description:
ATENÇÃO: LEIA ATENTAMENTE O COMUNICADO E AS ORIENTAÇÕES PARA INSCRIÇÃO ACIMA.

O Serviço de Apoio às Micro e Pequenas Empresas de Mato Grosso - SEBRAE/MT com Sede em Cuiabá/MT, assessorado pela empresa IEL/SC – Instituto Euvaldo Lodi de Santa Catarina, torna pública a realização do Processo Seletivo destinado a recrutar e selecionar candidatos para provimento de vagas existentes e formação de cadastro reserva, para o espaço ocupacional de Analista Técnico II - Engenharia Elétrica, observados os requisitos mínimos constantes descritos no comunicado em anexo.

Te damos as boas-vindas ao nosso processo seletivo 22/2025. Estamos felizes com o seu interesse em gerar a transformação junto aos pequenos negócios, que é o propósito do SEBRAE. Sobre os valores do SEBRAE? Ética, Foco no cliente, Cooperação, Resiliência, Inovação, Valorização Humana e Resultados Sustentáveis. E se você, assim como a gente quer fazer a diferença, aqui é o seu lugar, vamos juntos?!

Principais atividades do cargo:

  1. Noções sobre estudo, elaboração de projeto, direção, fiscalização, construção e manutenção de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo e outras áreas afins;
  2. Noções sobre engenharia legal, nos assuntos relacionados a projeto, direção, fiscalização e construção de obras de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo e outras áreas afins;
  3. Facilidade em desenhar, projetar e analisar construções, Aptidão para fazer cálculos e dimensionamentos;
  4. Conhecimento em Leis Municipais de Plano Diretor e uso e ocupação do solo;
  5. Conhecimento nas normas ABNT NBR 5410, NR 10, NR 12, NR 33 e NR35;
  6. Analisar, executar as demandas e ações referente as instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo e outras áreas de atribuições compatíveis com a especialização profissional, conforme as normas, procedimentos e diretrizes da organização;
  7. Representar as demandas de obras e reformas através plantas, cortes e detalhamentos;
  8. Descrever as atividades relacionadas às instalações elétricas e complementares referentes às obras e reformas através de memoriais descritivos;
  9. Acompanhar as obras, reformas e serviços de engenharia com realização de serviços como: planilha de Medição de Obra, planilha de aditivo de valor, parecer técnico para aditivo de valor, parecer técnico para reajuste de contratos, emissão de parecer técnico para prorrogação de prazo de contrato;
  10. Elaborar relatórios das obras, reformas e serviços de engenharia;
  11. Elaborar e Cronograma físico e financeiro de Obras;
  12. Realizar contratações e acompanhamento de fornecedores;
  13. Elaborar projetos de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo, Usina Fotovoltaica e outras áreas de atribuições compatíveis com a especialização profissional;
  14. Elaborar Planilha Orçamentária de Obras referente a projetos de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo e outras áreas de atribuições compatíveis com a especialização profissional;
  15. Elaborar Memorial Descritivo de Obras referente a projetos de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão, SPDA, rede lógica, telefonia, CFTV, alarme, som, vídeo e outras áreas de atribuições compatíveis com a especialização profissional;
  16. Garantir a conformidade do projeto com normas e regulamentações vigentes. Elaborar ETP, Termos de Referência, Memorando e Despachos necessários para contratação de serviços/produtos;
  17. Aprovar projetos junto a concessionárias de energia.

Requisitos:

  1. Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica (reconhecidos pelo MEC) com pós-graduação na área.
  2. Disponibilidade para viagens;
  3. Disponibilidade para residir em Cuiabá/MT;
  4. Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana;
  5. CNH categoria mínima “B”, válida.
  6. Registro ativo no CREA.

Experiência Obrigatória Necessária (mínimo 06 meses, em ao menos TRÊS (3) das atividades abaixo):

  1. Ter atuado com elaboração e análise de projetos elétricos, execução de obras e fiscalização.
  2. Ter atuado com quantificação de projetos, composição de custos de valores e planilhas orçamentárias de obras, cronogramas e especificações técnicas de projetos elétricos;
  3. Ter atuado com projetos de instalações elétricas de alta e baixa tensão e/ou SPDA e/ou rede lógica e/ou telefonia e/ou CFTV e/ou alarme e/ou som e/ou vídeo e/ou Usina Fotovoltaica e/ou outras áreas de atribuições compatíveis com a especialização profissional;
  4. Ter atuado com gestão de contratos de obras e serviços técnicos;
  5. Ter atuado com gestão de obras e fiscalização.

ATENÇÃO: Reserve um tempo para realizar sua inscrição, uma vez enviada não será possível editá-la.

Dúvidas? Entre em contato através do e-mail

Benefícios:

  1. Plano de Previdência Privada
  2. Assistência Médico-Hospitalar (sistema co-participativo)
  3. Auxílio Alimentação no valor de R$1.550,00/mensal

Sobre o Instituto Euvaldo Lodi:

O Instituto Euvaldo Lodi nasceu da integração da indústria e a educação: com o objetivo de levar o conhecimento acadêmico as empresas através de soluções da seguinte forma:

  1. Promover a interação da indústria e dos industriários com centros de conhecimento, contribuindo, dentro do espírito da livre iniciativa, para o aumento da competitividade e dos desenvolvimentos sustentável;
  2. Contribuir para o fortalecimento e a difusão do empreendedorismo;
  3. Contribuir para o aprimoramento da gestão e da educação empresarial.

Com as unidades regionais localizadas em todo o território nacional, o IEL implementa soluções inovadoras e customizadas às necessidades de cada empresa e cadeia de valor.

description:
Guarulhos - SP

Junte-se ao time de Serviços Financeiros do maior varejista do Brasil!

Na nossa empresa, acreditamos que o sucesso está baseado em cinco pilares fundamentais: Inclusão, Cliente, Coragem, Colaboração e Compromisso com a mudança.

Se você é proativo(a), adora um desafio, tem vontade de crescer profissionalmente e se sente motivado(a) a ser reconhecido(a) pelos seus resultados, essa vaga é para você! Estamos em busca de talentos comprometidos em gerar resultados excepcionais e que tenham prazer em relacionar-se com pessoas.

Aqui, valorizamos quem tem brilho nos olhos por encantar nossos clientes, garantindo que cada interação seja a melhor possível. Se você é resolutivo(a), humano(a) e busca sempre a melhor experiência, você é exatamente o que procuramos!

  2. Alcançar e superar objetivos de vendas, com a possibilidade de conquistar premiações de acordo com seu desempenho;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Experiência com vendas será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6x1 (incluindo feriados e finais de semana);
  • Carga horária: 8 horas diárias.

O que esperamos de você?

  • Ser uma pessoa apaixonada por desafios e com foco em resultados;
  • Proatividade e vontade de fazer a diferença;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e buscar soluções criativas para encantar os clientes.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário + benefícios;
  • Campanhas de incentivo;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional;
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador.

Não perca tempo, candidate-se agora e venha brilhar com a gente!

Benefícios adicionais:

  • Flexibilidade
  • Comunicação
  • Persuasão
  • PLR Semestral - Participação nos lucros e resultados
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Campanhas de incentivo/premiações
  • Desconto no cartão Carrefour para compras na Rede
  • Refeitório no local
  • Reembolso ótica

Já imaginou trabalhar no maior empregador privado do país? Venha com a gente! Somos 130 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros, colaborando assim com a saúde e o bem-estar de todos e todas.

Com a aquisição do grupo BIG, em junho de 2022, iniciamos uma nova etapa na nossa jornada de 47 anos no Brasil. Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos, tornando-nos uma empresa mais diversa, inovadora e capaz de causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Fortalecemos parcerias com fornecedores, produtores e investidores, oferecendo uma experiência cada vez melhor para nossos clientes em todo o país.

Investimos na simplificação e na aceleração digital, acreditando que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças, com espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais. E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.

description:
If digital transformation , next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams , earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world.

What is in it for you?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

What is the scope of this role?

Netcracker Technology is looking to hire a Business Analyst to join our Implementation Engineering teams located throughout the LATAM region. As a CRM/BSS Domain technological subject matter expert (SME), you will be responsible for leading a team providing cost-effective solutions to business and technical challenges faced in large/complex Telecommunications projects. Business Analysts are working as a company’s representatives in front of the enterprise customer. You will be responsible for defining and documenting measurable criteria for solution assessment, proposing solutions, and bringing best practices. It is expected that you will have recognition in the Telecommunications industry as a CRM or BSS Domain SME.

What will be your responsibilities?

  • The key element of the role is focused on analysis and project design, which can be delivered through the baseline capabilities of existing products. Most importantly - stakeholder management as well as expectation management.
  • Collecting and collating business requirements for Business-to-Business telecom products on various network technologies.
  • Guiding and coaching the business stakeholders through the requirements gathering process.
  • Providing clarification and acting as a point of reference for business requirement inquiries by solution design and project delivery teams.
  • Working with project teams to agree on an approach and keep them informed of progress.
  • Facilitating workshops required to understand and document detailed requirements and solution behavior.
  • Working closely with the delivery team to ensure functional and non-functional completeness of the solution.
  • Creating comprehensive and unambiguous documentation that outlines the requirements of stakeholders, traceable for the testing team and understandable for the development team. Developing comprehensive knowledge of the aligned business area and the trust of its business stakeholders.

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • Minimum 7+ years of sufficient technical knowledge to understand high-level architecture and technical requirements around BSS/CRM solutions for Telecom projects.
  • Experience with next-gen CRM and Converged Billing applications (CPQ, Order Management, Product Catalog, etc) .
  • Strong business analysis background, preferably in an internet/software development company.
  • Organizational skills, able to work simultaneously on a number of assignments when required.
  • Knowledge of business analysis principles and methodologies.
  • Proven ability to work BSS/CRM functionally to drive the accurate capture of requirements, resolving and closing down issues and information shortfall as they appear.
  • Experience of working within Waterfall & Agile methodology.
  • Ability to collaborate and solve challenges.
  • Proven experience of successfully working within transformation projects, or projects with B2B products.
  • Previous experience leading architecture teams.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese languages.
  • Availability to work from the office in a Hybrid mode (at least 3 times per week).

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

Who is Netcracker Technology?
We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people, and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.
